# ISSUE-83 plan refresh

Make hands-on work discoverable, attribute staged phases to their authenticated stager, and document the complete interactive workflow. Reopened after operator-reported partial checkpoint `dc9c757` and the explicit local-identity privacy constraint. Preserve the partial source and truthful incomplete IMPLEMENTATION.md; no issue-specific tests exist yet. This refresh retains the previously recorded approved base `b0f84e5e341385e6601509ffc64cdcb2dffc9e13` and exactly the six current criteria. Historical plans and reviews supply no current approval. Planning/source inspection only; no implementation, staging, publication, or test execution is authorized in this run.

## Dimensions and scope

Approved sensitive profile; advisory size medium, uncertainty medium. Estimated 11–14 hours for planning, implementation and validation within the 16-hour claim budget, with approved-input identity confirmed by the operator. Preserve independent security review without adding a gate: the current WorkUnit gate is `none`. Scope covers same-repository and own-fork issue/PR flows using existing harnesses; no adapters, automatic renewal, node scheduling, gate or plan_mode changes.

The remaining attribution, rendering and guide changes form one end-to-end human-led outcome within the claim budget. Lease-expiry reminder output and its tests moved intact to dependent WorkUnit322 and are excluded here. The guide and generated pointers still document the existing `swarm issue renew` command. No reminder helper, threshold, output or reminder test changes belong in ISSUE-83.

## What we know

- `internal/cli/stage.go:22,154,345` shares issue/PR staging and supplies descriptive harness/model/host metadata; plan_mode agent blocks manual planning at line 168. Plan and implementation staging record multiple artifacts, including validation. These prior-plan references predate the partial checkpoint; current symbols are additionally referenced in the reopened design below.
- `internal/contract/types.go:251` converts role attestations to metadata. `internal/lease/manager.go:455` replaces role attestations, preserving missing artifact bindings; current `TesterMetadata` at `:2135–2154` overlays prior tester provenance then clears staging/execution labels. Verify replacement and reuse behavior with the still-missing tests.
- `internal/lease/manager.go:1564` strips trusted validation/implementation prefixes before gateway forwarding and fenced mutation. Trusted implementation/retry code is now present and must be preserved. `RecordTrustedValidation` at line 1557 deliberately grants trusted origin only without a gateway.
- Fork `actionTracker.CurrentUser` (`internal/fork/coordinator.go:63`) uses the verified event actor; `update-artifact` dispatch is at line 407. Payload actor, owner, producer and coordinator account cannot establish stager identity.
- Initial descriptions already call `lease.ComposePRDescription` (`internal/cli/submit.go:354`); updates do too (`internal/pr/review_projection.go:14`). `internal/lease/pr_description.go:13,187` enforces a 59,999-byte limit and managed sections; its tests cover human prose, UTF-8, allocation, recovery and marker ambiguity.
- Status entry is `internal/cli/status.go:45`. Current validation callers include `internal/cli/submit.go:161`, `internal/pr/service.go:1189` and issue validate. Fresh workflow execution is distinct (`internal/workflow/guidance.go:42`, `execute_validation.go:93`).
- `internal/workspace/pr.go:22` and issue bundle construction in `internal/workspace/worktree.go` emit active pointers; safefs/marker cleanup is at worktree.go:1026,1094,1131. Modify generated blocks only.
- Commands were inspected against registrations: issue claim (`claim.go:18,130`), stage (`stage.go:345–349`), review-plan (`review_plan.go:94–100`), renew (`lease.go:11,76`), validate (`validate.go:89–91`); PR verbs (`pr.go:41–45`) are status/work/rebase/validate/submit and stage. There is no PR renew or PR review-plan. Global fork/remote/backend selectors are registered in `root.go:117–122`. PR work accepts `--phase` at pr.go:287.

## What we're assuming

Optional string attestation fields should preserve old wire and digest behavior; verify against legacy serialized fixtures during implementation. No dependency on PR321 is introduced; its shared test files remain untouched.

## Approved-input evidence and open questions

**Operator facts (not sandbox Git inspection):** the operator verified the Git-backed checkout HEAD is exactly approved `b0f84e5e341385e6601509ffc64cdcb2dffc9e13`, and `git ls-tree` of that base confirms `docs/human-led.md` and each `internal/{cli,lease,fork,pr,workspace,contract}/human_led_issue83_test.go` are absent. These are new files at the approved base. The missing `.git` in this snapshot is expected isolation; no further base-confirmation approval or environment prerequisite is required.

The former identity conflict is resolved by the operator’s explicit privacy constraint. One implementation question remains: which generated prose and telemetry fields repeat structured actors? The reopened design’s projection inventory and matrix answer this before implementation completion; do not expand to arbitrary content redaction. No blocking environment question remains. Step 4 resolves which existing evidence supports fresh execution versus reused provenance and tests unknown fallbacks. Step 6 verifies all final guide argv against Cobra. Live publication and personal harness permissions can be checked in an optional maintainer walkthrough; locally testable acceptance does not wait on those environments. Independent security review follows planning before implementation, as requested by the operator; it does not change the WorkUnit's configured gate `none`.

## Architecture and implementation sequence

Exact modified production/docs paths: `internal/contract/types.go` (RoleAttestation, Metadata); `internal/lease/manager.go` (RecordRoleAttestation, updateArtifact, TesterMetadata, BuildProvenanceAttestation as needed); `internal/lease/pr_description.go` (shared role summary alongside existing composer); `internal/cli/stage.go` (metaForRole); `internal/cli/status.go` (newStatusCmd provenance rendering); `internal/cli/submit.go` (draftPRSection); `internal/pr/review_projection.go` (ProjectReviewEvidence); `internal/workspace/worktree.go` (compileHarnessBundle); `internal/workspace/pr.go` (CompilePRHarnessBundleAt); `README.md`; `docs/developer.md`. Fork coordinator, validation callers and workflow execution are evidence and regression targets; preserve their authority and invocation behavior unchanged. Projection call sites in submit.go and review_projection.go must pass trusted backend context.

1. **Use approved inputs and file inventory.** Use the operator-confirmed base above and recheck implementation symbols against this snapshot, preserving trusted implementation/retry and PR composition. Modify only the production files named below. New files, confirmed absent at that approved base by the operator: `docs/human-led.md` (already present in partial checkpoint; continue modifying it); `internal/{cli,lease,fork,pr,workspace,contract}/human_led_issue83_test.go` (still absent in snapshot). Put shared production helpers in existing `internal/lease/manager.go` and `internal/lease/pr_description.go`; reuse the existing composer.

2. **Add optional staging provenance (criterion 2).** Modify RoleAttestation and Metadata in contract/types.go with optional ProductionMode, StagedBy, HarnessSource, ModelSource. stage.go declares interactive mode on design, test-plan, implementation and staged validation. At updateArtifact entry unconditionally strip caller staged_by/harness_source/model_source for every artifact type/mode, alongside existing trusted-prefix stripping, before gateway forwarding. At authoritative fenced mutation, interactive mode requires nonempty CurrentUser and sets stager and both self-reported labels. Fork receipt repeats sanitization through the manager and derives actor only from actionTracker. Lookup error/empty identity fails without artifact writes. Never add credentials or an identity source; GitHub uses authenticated login, fork verified author, local backend its existing local identity as private local metadata/status only; local PR projections must omit it everywhere.
3. **Prevent stale attribution (criteria 2–4).** Role replacement must clear old interactive fields, even when retaining artifact type/digest. TesterMetadata clears attribution and execution_mode/authentication from both copied base and prior-attestation overlay, retaining prior harness/model details and current validation bindings. Stage explicitly reapplies this operation's declaration afterward. Preserve fresh workflow RunResult metadata and trusted implementation/retry logic. Preserve general Metadata conversion semantics, schema version, legacy JSON/YAML omission and digest behavior; do not migrate or rewrite old attestations. No caller-writable freshness/trust marker.
4. **Share descriptive role summaries (criteria 3–4).** Add a shared formatter in lease used by status.go, draftPRSection and ProjectReviewEvidence. Derive current role evidence from current artifacts and matching attestation bindings. Interactive: named authenticated stager, self-reported harness/model. Fresh positive execution evidence: headless agent run, configured agent/harness and authoritative lease owner; this is descriptive provenance, never verified mode or gate authority. Reused tester provenance with valid fenced validation origin/owner/claim and usable current bindings: coordinator validation by claim owner, prior runner provenance reused (or unknown without runner details). Legacy/missing/unusable evidence stays unknown. Human review remains human; call a reviewer sandboxed only with actual boundary evidence. Fork standalone validation has no trusted coordinator origin and remains unknown; fork execution_mode remains descriptive, never coordinator authentication. Sanitize newlines/table delimiters and managed-marker text in untrusted values. Keep optional JSON compatibility.
5. **Reuse PR composition (criterion 4).** Add short summaries within existing managed issue-description/review-evidence sections using DescriptionText/Slot/AtomicSlot as appropriate and ComposePRDescription. Do not create a second body composer or append unmanaged summaries. Preserve human prose byte-for-byte, titles, draft/ready state, attestation/digests, telemetry, retrieval inventory, byte bounds and idempotence. Exercise initial issue submit and continuing PR submit, same-repository and fork paths.
6. **Complete pointers and guide (criteria 1,5).** Update only generated pointer format strings in workspace/worktree.go and pr.go for both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md. Show ordered plan, plan stage, applicable issue review-plan, implement, validate, implementation stage, linked issue renew and explicit submit. PRs use PR stage/validate/submit and the linked issue's renew/review commands. Preserve marker/root-bound handling. Write human-led.md and link README.md and developer.md Choose how you work. Explain why hands-on work helps, host permissions/approval prompts, Git checkout isolation, trusted-base validation and isolated agent review. Cover claim/worktree, slash commands (or equivalent prompts where unavailable), both review gates and none, agent-only plan restriction, same-repo and own-fork PR preparation using registered `pr work --phase plan`. Do not imply claim ownership enables self-approval. Verify actual command argument semantics before final examples; no invented PR claim/renew/review-plan.
7. **Verify criterion 6 and independent review.** Implement issue-specific tests from TEST_PLAN.md; preserve independent actor/gate/fence regressions. Do not edit fixture_helpers_test.go, cli_test.go or environment_test.go during PR321 work. Existing helpers may be called unchanged. Run focused tests, then required checks and make check in implementation/validation, not this planning run. Independent review before implementation focuses on authoritative actor assignment, fork trust, reused provenance, legacy digests/wire behavior, PR bounds and unchanged approval enforcement; it does not replace configured gates.

## Reopened design: trusted projection context and local privacy

This section resolves the former identity conflict and qualifies steps 2–5 throughout this plan. A local `CurrentUser` is a local alias, never an authenticated GitHub identity. Keep the existing `TestCLIInteractiveStageProvenanceAndPlanCommand` and every assertion unchanged (`internal/cli/cli_test.go:620,675`). Do not modify cli_test.go, environment_test.go, or active PR321 fixture helpers. Do not encode, rename, substitute, or globally search-and-replace an alias to pass the assertion.

Confirmed current source evidence:

- `internal/lease/manager.go:1589–1598,1757` assigns CurrentUser to staged_by inside fenced mutation and copies it to role attestations. Private local retention is allowed. The sanitized forwarding path is at `:1564`.
- `internal/lease/pr_description.go:408,412,419,428` renders stager, review actor, lease owner and validation owner without projection context; `:326–341` renders artifact Producer and body. `manager.go:497–540` copies raw role attestations. These are separate potential leaks; summary-only suppression is insufficient.
- `internal/cli/submit.go:200,328–356` composes the initial body and raw JSON; `internal/pr/review_projection.go:14–24` composes continuing PR evidence through a tracker. `status.go:176` may retain private local actors.
- Actual GitHub backend names are `github (owner/repo)` (`internal/tracker/github.go:154`), local is `local` (`local.go:70`); do not implement an equality-to-`github` check that suppresses real GitHub publication. Existing manager backend handling is at `manager.go:189`. Fork `actionTracker` embeds the upstream tracker and returns the verified event actor (`internal/fork/coordinator.go:56–69`). Payload backend labels are not evidence.

Implementation sequence addition (before completing summary/composition):

1. Introduce a small explicit projection context in existing lease/pr_description.go, constructed from the trusted tracker/backend at coordinator-owned call sites. Distinguish private status, public local projection, and authenticated GitHub projection; missing/unknown context defaults to actor suppression. Do not serialize context as caller-writable artifact metadata or add an identity lookup. Thread this through initial issue submission, direct formatDraftPRBody compatibility entry, continuing PR projection, and shared inventory/summary/raw-attestation formatting. Direct helpers without trusted context must default to privacy. Inspect all callers with repository searches before changing signatures; preserve existing tests/callers using safe wrappers where needed.
2. Project a copy of state/attestation data for public rendering; never mutate private source artifacts, persisted state, digests, or approvals. Audit every actor-bearing field: staged_by, review actor, human Producer, lease/claim owner, trusted validation owner, raw Roles, artifact inventories, generated review prose, telemetry and reused evidence. Local projections omit identity values and retain honest descriptions such as interactive staging, human review, headless execution or coordinator validation without naming a person. Suppress structured/generated local identity at its source; do not redact arbitrary human-authored PR prose or artifact content by matching alias strings. Existing outside-section prose preservation remains binding. If generated artifact prose currently embeds an alias, render its public evidence from structured nonidentity fields without rewriting stored artifact bodies or digests. No blanket removal of attestation inventories or production summaries.
3. GitHub projections publish only actors established through the existing authenticated tracker/verified fork coordinator mutation path, with current artifact bindings. Do not treat arbitrary metadata actor/producer/owner, a coordinator bot, or a backend label in a request as authenticated authorship. Backend context permits publication; it does not authenticate every string in an artifact. Review legacy actor evidence conservatively and use unknown/unnamed fallback where authentication cannot be established. Preserve genuine GitHub stager names and self-reported harness/model, sanitize display delimiters/newlines/managed markers, and keep valid JSON. Legacy wire behavior remains unchanged absent optional fields.
4. Complete the draft summary's remaining evidence handling: human review must work without a role attestation; fresh headless evidence must match current bindings; reused validation must not become fresh execution; missing/stale evidence remains unknown; sandbox claims require real boundary evidence. Test local suppression for each branch, and authenticated GitHub publication for the same branches where actor evidence exists. Continue all original metadata, gate, documentation, pointer, composition, command-registration and validation work; fixing the single failing assertion does not complete this WorkUnit.

No Git metadata is available in this sandbox (`git status`/`git show` report not a repository); checkpoint identity and approved-base absence remain operator/prior-plan evidence, not newly verified Git facts. Snapshot inspection confirms human-led.md exists and all six proposed issue-specific test files are absent. No production source or IMPLEMENTATION.md is changed during planning. Independent security review follows these artifacts before implementation. No claim, stage, publication or test run is part of this planning task.

## HANDOFF

Add public context to shared renderers while preserving safe direct entry points.
- Entry points: stage.go:22,154; contract/types.go:251; manager.go:455,1564,2119; coordinator.go:63,407; status.go:45; submit.go:328,354; review_projection.go:14; pr_description.go:187; workspace/pr.go:22 and worktree.go:1026; validate.go:75; pr/service.go:1189. References are snapshot evidence and must be rechecked against approved input.

Add issue-specific tests beside lease/pr_description_test.go, contract/attestation_test.go, pr/review_projection_test.go and workspace/pr_test.go; do not modify shared fixture or large CLI/environment test files. The operator confirmed approved-base absence of all proposed new files.
- Focused commands: `go test ./internal/contract ./internal/lease ./internal/fork ./internal/cli ./internal/pr ./internal/workspace -run 'Issue83'`; `go test ./internal/agent ./internal/workflow`; preserve and run existing description, actor, gate, fence, validation-reuse and pointer regression tests as specified in TEST_PLAN.md.
- Checked assumptions: registrations inspected directly; shared composer/trusted retry present; partial interactive metadata present and TesterMetadata draft clears execution evidence; neither is accepted as complete. Approved HEAD and new-file absence are operator-verified facts, not sandbox Git findings.
- Reopen for base mismatch, new required gate authority, credential access, identity-source change, trusted-policy change, inability to preserve PR bounds/prose, or scope exceeding the claim budget. Do not implement around these conditions or add unrelated improvements.
- **What this change breaks:** searches show stage.go's metadata assertions and existing interactive/status fixtures in cli_test.go depend on old output; preserve every assertion, especially the alice leak rejection, and add issue-specific tests for local omission and authenticated GitHub publication. Update public rendering with trusted context; status may retain local aliases. RoleAttestation JSON/Metadata fixtures (contract/attestation_test.go) depend on optional fields: preserve old-wire expectations. TesterMetadata callers in validate.go, submit.go and pr/service.go must lose stale execution attribution while fresh workflow paths remain intact. Description tests in lease/pr_description_test.go, CLI submit_description_test.go and PR review_projection_test.go depend on managed markers/inventory/bounds: preserve those contracts, add summary coverage. Workspace pointer fixtures, checkpoint/dirty-tree and instruction-symlink tests depend on marker stripping: preserve unchanged and add sequence assertions. README/developer links and interactive sections need only guide links and corrections required by this guide; retain visuals and voice. Slash definitions in .claude/commands and .opencode/commands are reference evidence, preserve unchanged unless an actual contradiction requires reopening the plan. Independent actor, human-gate, claim-fence, trusted-base and fork regressions remain unchanged.

## Required independent security cases

Use proposed `human_led_issue83_test.go` files in internal/cli, lease, fork, pr, workspace and contract whose absence at the approved base the operator confirmed. Reuse helpers unchanged. Do not edit fixture_helpers_test.go, cli_test.go or environment_test.go; existing regressions in them remain independently runnable.

- Actor fixtures distinguish authenticated login/verified fork author, payload actor/owner/producer, coordinator bot, OS username, hostname, paths and environment sentinels. Only existing authenticated GitHub identity enters GitHub public actor fields; backend context alone never authenticates caller metadata. Local backend may retain its alias in private metadata/status, but every local PR projection omits that alias, including raw attestation JSON and artifact inventory. Absence of a GitHub API call does not establish privacy. Raw fork request bypasses client sanitizer and still cannot forge actor/source labels, trusted implementation/validation prefixes or approvals.
- Preserve independent human gate self-approval rejection, agent gate binding, plan_mode agent rejection, advisory fork review limitations, stale claim fencing, policy-base pinning and root-bound file tests. Interactive metadata cannot satisfy any gate, change review digests, establish sandboxing, or grant trusted validation. Do not combine these into one fixture that could conceal an independent failure.
- Replace interactive role with fresh adapter attestation, including missing artifact type/digest retention: old stager/mode/source fields disappear. Reverse replacement uses only current authenticated stager. Old optional-wire artifacts decode/validate/submit unchanged; golden legacy JSON/YAML and provenance digests remain identical when new optional fields are absent. New fields round-trip without changing review/task/policy digest inputs.
- Seed interactive tester and separately fresh headless tester. Standalone issue validate, PR validate and shared submit-validation paths clear interactive attribution plus execution_mode/authentication from base map and overlay, retaining prior runner details and correct current validation bindings. Interactive staging then overrides with current declaration/actor.
- In status, initial issue PR description and updated PR description, standalone local coordinator validation with valid origin/owner/claim/current binding says coordinator validation by claim owner and prior runner provenance reused (or unknown without details). Invalid/absent origin/bindings gives unknown. Fork standalone validation stays unknown, never coordinator validation; fresh fork execution evidence remains descriptive only. No new writable freshness marker.
- Control: a fresh configured RunResult passed through workflow runMetadata and RecordTrustedValidation remains headless despite coordinator origin. Reused tester metadata cannot claim a fresh run. Preserve current trusted implementation/retry eligibility and attestation bindings; no changes to retry authority.

## Reopened privacy and authenticated-publication regression matrix

Add these Issue83 cases in the six proposed test files; preserve all old tests and assertions. Do not use/edit active PR321 fixture helpers or edit cli_test.go/environment_test.go. Local issue fixtures may use existing independent helpers unchanged; add isolated package-local GitHub/fork doubles in the Issue83 files.

| Projection/evidence | Local expectation | Authenticated GitHub expectation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Issue plan and implementation staging, plus PR staging | Private artifact/attestation and status can retain local alias; no public description contains it | Actual authenticated stager in artifacts and rendered summaries/raw JSON; both source labels self-reported |
| Initial draftPRSection/formatDraftPRBody and issue submit | Entire generated body excludes alice and a distinct local sentinel, not merely summary; raw JSON remains parseable and retains nonidentity provenance | Same-repo submit actually publishes the authenticated login in summary and JSON; spoofed payload login never replaces it |

Parse projected attestation JSON and assert field omission for local versus exact authenticated staged_by for GitHub. Assert aliases were not encoded/renamed and state/artifacts/digests are unchanged after rendering. Rendering-only adversarial fixtures additionally cover newline, pipe, Unicode, code-fence and managed-marker input; assert marker safety, valid JSON/UTF-8 and byte bounds. Preserve arbitrary outside human prose exactly; projection privacy concerns generated actor fields and generated identity-bearing prose, not arbitrary user-authored occurrences of a matching word.

Run the unchanged `TestCLIInteractiveStageProvenanceAndPlanCommand` explicitly with `-count=1`; passing requires retaining alice exclusion and all provenance/artifact assertions. New positive GitHub publication tests are mandatory alongside this existing negative test. Exercise all six acceptance rows above; no acceptance item is complete based only on this regression fix.
